in_sanskrit.name: Pintu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little One
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pintu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Pintu is a Hindi and Sanskrit name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pinda' meaning 'mound', 'heap' or 'grain'. It is often used as a term of endearment for a little one, or a small, insignificant or unimportant person. In the context of spirituality, Pintu is also associated with the idea of a small, humble or insignificant soul, on the path towards enlightenment.
